title: Azure CLI, Azure PowerShell and Cloud Shell

videos.script: Most of what you will ever do in Azure, you can do from a command line. This lesson reads that command line closely. {{cli}} The Azure CLI knows every command and every parameter before anything leaves your computer. {{help}} Leave out a name, and it refuses on the spot. Nobody needs to sign in for that. {{refuse}} Defaults save typing. They also send a command to the wrong place, the day you forget one is set. {{defaults}} So you will ask the CLI where each setting came from. It tells you. {{config}} Every answer is JSON underneath. You will cut it down with a query, and print it as a table, as tab-separated values, or as YAML. {{query}} Then the other command line, Azure PowerShell, which returns objects instead of text. {{powershell}} And Cloud Shell, a terminal in the browser that is already signed in. It is handy for five minutes, and it forgets. {{cloudshell}} By the end, you can read any az command somebody hands you, and say where it will land. {{end}}
